messages:
nina: Heads up — compliance asked for a single export that lets auditors answer "who changed routing/quotas and why" across a rollout. they want both the diff and the rollout trace id. 
sam: Do they need the full policy snapshots or just the diffs + refs?
nina: Prefer diffs + prior/after refs to avoid storing huge blobs. but must be reconstructable. link to rollout trace is required.
kevin: We have three constraints: 1) must be tamper-evident 2) PII redaction options 3) efficient for big orgs.
mia: For tamper-evident we could sign each export chunk with a key and include manifest.json with signatures. auditors can verify.
jorge: signing is fine, but how do we attach the runtime evidence? e.g., when a routing policy change caused a quota enforcement spike — need the metric snapshot + sample requests.
akash: Maybe attach a minimal replay bundle: span ID + sample request IDs (hashed) + metric window. Not full payloads unless allowed.
sam: That implies we need per-change metadata: change_id, actor, justification, rollout_id, rollout_step, effective_time, routes_affected[], quota_rules_changed[], telemetry_snapshot_ref.
nina: Exactly. Also want an audit export format easy to query: NDJSON lines where each line is an "event" (change, metric_snapshot, sample_ref, signature).
kevin: We debated NDJSON earlier. My only pushback: query performance for long tails. But if we partition by org_id + time it's fine.
mia: Also add a compact change diff shape: only include mutated fields and their token path, e.g. {"op": "replace", "path": "/routes/0/priority", "before": 10, "after": 8}. small and precise.
jorge: +1. For rollout linkage, we need to ensure rollout_id maps to the console rollout timeline. console should show an anchor that links to the export record.
nina: UX ask: when someone views a change in console, show an "export bundle id" with a permalink to download signed NDJSON for that timeline slice.
akash: Ops concern: exports could be large if we include telemetry windows. We should allow sampling policy: full, sample-1pct, metadata-only. Default to metadata-only plus a sampled telemetry bundle per change.
sam: We also need retention controls per customer for exported bundles and a config for PII redaction levels (none, hash, redact).
mia: For internal API shape I propose: POST /v1/admin/audit/export {org_id, time_range, include: [diffs,telemetry,samples], sample_rate, redact_level} -> returns export_id + presigned S3 url stream or job id.
kevin: Sounds OK. But for streaming compliance teams want incremental NDJSON over HTTP so they can start verification before the full job completes. Support chunked transfer + signature trailer.
nina: Good. Add a signed manifest line at the end containing overall hash + signature. auditors prefer end-of-stream sig to verify completeness.
jorge: Security: rotation of export signing keys must be surfaced, and each bundle must include key_id header so orgs can fetch the cert.
akash: Implementation question: where do we compute diffs? Control plane at write-time has before/after objects; we can emit a change event with diff attached. Replayable.
sam: If we emit diffs at write-time we need to persist the before snapshot for reconstruction. Alternatively compute a lightweight diff and store references to archived snapshots when needed.
mia: Storage tradeoff. Maybe keep full snapshots for only privileged resources (routing policies & quota rules), TTL = 90 days by default, and archive older snapshots on customer request.
kevin: For export schema let's sketch example NDJSON lines in the thread so infra can prototype.
nina: Here — quick sample:
```
{"type": "change", "change_id": "chg_01F...", "actor": "sam", "time": "2026-03-15T18:23:12Z", "resource": "routing/policy/abcd", "diffs": [{"op":"replace","path":"/routes/1/weight","before":50,"after":30}], "rollout_id": "rl_987"}
{"type": "telemetry_snapshot", "rollout_id": "rl_987", "window": {"start":"2026-03-15T18:20:00Z", "end":"2026-03-15T18:25:00Z"}, "metrics": {"quota_hits": 1200, "errors": 3}}
{"type": "sample_ref", "request_hashes": ["sha256:..."], "sample_policy": "1pct"}
{"type": "signature", "key_id": "export-key-v2", "signature": "base64..."}
```
kevin: Nice. infra note: keep each line standalone JSON for streaming parse. good.
sam: Question for legal/security: is including hashed request IDs enough for them to reconstruct incidents?
nina: I'll loop in legal if needed. For now assume hashed refs + ability to request full samples under subpoena.
audit-bot: export job created: export_20260315_001 by sam. status: queued.
jorge: Next steps: prototype API + small console button to create export for a single change. Engineering owners: sam (API), mia (console), kevin (security), jorge (infra).
akash: I'll add a quick RFC doc with schema and retention defaults — will ping the thread.
nina: Thanks. Can we add a constraint: exports must not block rollouts (async only)?
sam: yes, async only. we'll add rate limits + throttles per org.
mia: I'll add a console UX mock: export button + sampling dropdown + signed bundle download.
nina: Great — assign owners and we'll reconvene after RFC. :thumbsup:
